character_presets.summary: Fenborn clerk. Hears false tides and carries a council mark.
Kilnborn lock-runner. Climbs heat and avoids the council.

choices.summary: Hear false currents and carry the basin's old tide sense.
Read furnace heat and endure the Red Sluice's burning stone.
Known around the market and connected to the flood council.
Raised among gate crews who remember practical solidarity.
A practiced auditor with sharp insight and a measured voice.
A fast climber and lockpicker built for dangerous routes.
Institutions can still protect people when held to account.
No authority deserves obedience merely because it claims control.
A dangerous obligation makes every generous choice more costly.
Council notices circulate wherever guards still honor old warrants.
You pulled a trapped worker free and promised to warn Lowsail.
You exposed a gate fault by taking the permit that concealed it.

locations.name: Lowsail Checkpoint
locations.description: A red warning orders you to redirect the next surge at Red Sluice. Sava guards Lowsail's dry checkpoint.

description_variants.text: Floodwater reaches the checkpoint; choose Enter Lowsail Aftermath to face the damage.
The Sluice decision is settled; choose Enter Lowsail Aftermath to see what changed.
The chain stands open; Sava directs you to the Authority Path at Lowsail Levee.
Sava studies the forged order beside the raised chain; Red Sluice still needs your answer.
The posted warning points to Red Sluice; Sava keeps both roads open.
Sava points east from the raised chain; follow the levee road to Red Sluice.
Sava lifts the chain for your council mark; redirect the next surge at Red Sluice.
Sava watches your wanted face while workers leave a gap; reach Red Sluice before the next surge.
Sava bars the chain after your threat; find another way to Red Sluice before the surge.

locations.name: Lowsail Docks
locations.description: Boats knock against the docks. Oren watches a courier skiff beside a locked tide chest.

description_variants.text: Floodwater fills the docks; choose Enter Lowsail Aftermath to face the damage.
The Sluice decision has changed these docks; choose Enter Lowsail Aftermath to see the result.
The docks stand empty beneath the warning bell.
Yara keeps the Tide Key low and trusts the runner near her skiff.

locations.name: Lowsail Levee
locations.description: The levee road runs east to Red Sluice. Workers brace the wet embankment.

description_variants.text: Floodwater runs below the levee; choose Enter Lowsail Aftermath to face the damage.
The Sluice decision is settled beyond the levee; choose Enter Lowsail Aftermath to see what changed.
The levee crew watches the eastern road, waiting for Edrik's reply.
The levee crew moves uphill because Lowsail expects the next surge.

locations.name: Red Sluice Floor
locations.description: Water pounds the lower gate. Edrik holds a broken gauge above the intake.

description_variants.text: The missed surge has passed the lower gate; choose Enter Lowsail Aftermath to face the flood.
Your Sluice decision is settled; choose Enter Lowsail Aftermath to see the result.
Water pounds the lower gate while Edrik knows Lowsail has been warned.
The broken gauge hums in a safe pattern and Edrik sees a shared route.
Heat marks reveal stress above the intake.

locations.name: Red Sluice Top
locations.description: Mira waits beside the control wheels. A hot service ladder climbs into steam.

description_variants.text: The missed surge has flooded Lowsail; choose Enter Lowsail Aftermath to face the damage.
This surge is settled; choose Enter Lowsail Aftermath to see the result.
Mira points to a relief wheel that gives the warned market one safe escape.
Mira steadies the wheels while the rescued crew waits beside the hot ladder.

locations.name: Lowsail Return
locations.description: The water has changed the market. Stalls, prices, and guards show who controls the tide.

description_variants.text: The market stands above calm water while both shores still receive a share.
Lowsail stays dry while the upland works crack above the lowered water.
Empty stalls mark the old market as families carry goods toward higher ground.
The old ferry channel runs clear as Oren raises a free-route flag.
Water fills the lower stalls while the market pays for the broken gates.

timed_events.label: Lowsail surge
timed_events.result: The surge hits before you redirect it. Lowsail floods.

actions.label: Travel
actions.result: You move along the connected path.

actions.label: Wait Tide
actions.result: The tide shifts one step.

actions.label: Read Warning
actions.result: Go to the Red Sluice and redirect the next surge before it floods Lowsail.

actions.label: Ask Sava
actions.result: Sava points east: the levee road reaches the Red Sluice.

result_variants.text: Sava points east toward the guarded Red Sluice, one hand near the alarm.

effects.subject: The player asked at the checkpoint.

actions.label: Audit Order
actions.result: The order fails your check. Sava sees the forgery.

result_variants.text: Your council mark exposes the forged water order, and Sava accepts your proof.
Your wanted name makes the proof risky, but Sava sees the forged water order.

effects.subject: The water order is forged.
The player found a false water order.

actions.label: Show Charter
actions.result: Sava honors your charter, opening the Authority Path at Lowsail Levee.

effects.subject: The player showed a council charter.

actions.label: Blend Workers
actions.result: The workers hide your passage from the checkpoint.

effects.subject: The player slipped through with the workers.

actions.label: Recall Earlier Rescue
actions.result: Sava recalls your earlier rescue at the levee.

effects.subject: Sava remembered the player's earlier rescue.

actions.label: Pressure Guard
actions.result: The guard sounds an alarm and remembers the threat.

effects.subject: The wanted player pressured the guard.

actions.label: Use Stolen Permit
actions.result: The stolen permit opens a route but marks you as a risk.

effects.subject: Sava saw a stolen permit at the checkpoint.

actions.label: Search Crate
actions.result: You find rope marks near the locked tide chest.

actions.label: Ring Warning
actions.result: You sound the market warning. Oren orders every crew uphill; relay his warning at Lowsail Levee so Edrik can open relief.

effects.subject: Lowsail expects a surge.
The player rang the market warning bell.

actions.label: Ask Oren
actions.result: Oren reveals the submerged Culvert Path at Lowsail Levee. Take it into the Sluice, climb to Red Sluice Top, then break the toll.

effects.subject: Oren showed the player the submerged culvert.

actions.label: Follow Yara
actions.result: Yara leads you to the submerged culvert.

effects.subject: The player knows the submerged culvert route.
The player followed Yara without raising an alarm.

actions.label: Audit Ledger
actions.result: The ledger exposes a false order; Oren sends the evidence to Sava.

effects.subject: The water order is forged.
The water order is forged.
The player read the tide ledger.

actions.label: Press Yara
actions.result: Yara trusts your scar and offers the Tide Key.

effects.subject: The Tide Key is safe with the player.
The lock-runner earned Yara's respect.

actions.label: Trade Warning
actions.result: Oren moves ferries after your warning.

effects.subject: Lowsail expects a surge.
The player helped Oren warn the ferries.

actions.label: Inspect Damage
actions.result: Fresh marks show water struck the levee.

actions.label: Help Worker
actions.result: You pull the worker clear. Their report reaches Mira, Red Sluice's crew leader.

effects.subject: The player helped a worker on the levee.

actions.label: Send Report
actions.result: Sava's report reaches Edrik through the levee.

effects.subject: The water order is forged.
The engineer received Sava's report.

actions.label: Relay Warning
actions.result: Oren's warning reaches Edrik; he can now help open relief at Red Sluice Floor.

effects.subject: Lowsail expects a surge.
A ferry rumor warned Edrik about the market.

actions.label: Take Authority Path
actions.result: The charter opens the guarded Sluice path.

actions.label: Take Culvert Path
actions.result: The hidden culvert opens below the Sluice.

actions.label: Take Stolen Path
actions.result: The stolen permit gets you past the Red Sluice guard.

actions.label: Test Pressure
actions.result: The gauge shows pressure building below the gate.

result_variants.text: Edrik accepts your seal, then shows pressure building below the gate.
Edrik eyes the culvert mud while the gauge shows rising pressure.
Edrik doubts your permit while the gauge shows rising pressure.

actions.label: Stabilize Gauge
actions.result: The gauge steadies and Edrik lowers his guard.

effects.subject: The player stabilized the broken gauge.

actions.label: Read Harmonics
actions.result: You hear a safe split in the gate. Check the wheels at Red Sluice Top, then choose Split Flow.

effects.subject: The Fenborn clerk read the gate harmonics.
The gate harmonics reveal a safe split.

actions.label: Dive Intake
actions.result: The intake map reveals a safe split. Check the wheels at Red Sluice Top.

effects.subject: The Fenborn player mapped the flooded intake.

actions.label: Climb Hot Face
actions.result: Heat marks guide your climb above the intake.

effects.subject: The Kilnborn lock-runner climbed the hot service face.

actions.label: Open Relief
actions.result: A relief channel can now spare the warned market.

result_variants.text: Edrik follows the warning and opens the safer channel.

effects.subject: A relief channel can spare the market.
The player opened a relief channel after the warning.

actions.label: Force Wheel
actions.result: The wheel breaks free and the upper crew needs help.

effects.subject: The wanted lock-runner forced the gate wheel.

actions.label: Acknowledge Report
actions.result: Edrik confirms the report and prepares the gauge.

effects.subject: Edrik acknowledged the forged-order report.

actions.label: Check Wheels
actions.result: The control wheels turn, but the split still needs a choice.

actions.label: Rescue Worker
actions.result: Mira's worker reaches the platform.

effects.subject: The player rescued a worker at the wheels.

actions.label: Split Flow
actions.result: The gates share water between both shores.

result_variants.text: The rescued crew turns together, splitting water safely between both shores.

effects.subject: The player split the flow between both communities.

actions.label: Hold Market
actions.result: The market stays dry while the upland works lose water.

effects.subject: The player locked water toward the market.

actions.label: Divert Relief
actions.result: The relief channel takes the surge away from the market.

effects.subject: The player sent the surge through the relief channel.

actions.label: Break Toll
actions.result: The old channel opens and tolls lose their grip.

effects.subject: The player opened the old ferry channel.

actions.label: Overload Gates
actions.result: The gates fail and flood water reaches the market.

effects.subject: The player overloaded the gates and flooded the market.

actions.label: Signal Market
actions.result: Mira sends a warning signal to Oren before the surge.

effects.subject: The Sluice sent a signal before the surge.
The Sluice sent a signal before the surge.
Oren received a Sluice signal.

actions.label: Enter Lowsail Aftermath
actions.result: You enter Lowsail's aftermath and face what the changed water has done.

actions.label: Read Tide
actions.result: The changed water tells you who gained control.

result_variants.text: Calm water leaves both shores with a fair share.
Low water keeps Lowsail dry while the upland works lose their supply.
Empty stalls show that families moved before the surge.
Open water gives Oren a route beyond the toll.
Flooded stalls mark the cost of the broken gates.

actions.label: Ask Oren
actions.result: Oren names the price of the new water route.

effects.subject: Oren saw the player return after the surge.

actions.label: Seal Water Accord
actions.result: You seal an accord that keeps both shores supplied.

result_variants.text: Mira records the shared flow as a new market charter.

effects.subject: The player returned after sharing the water.

actions.label: Enforce Council Claim
actions.result: You enforce council control while the upland works absorb the loss.

effects.subject: The player returned with the market protected.

actions.label: Open Highland Market
actions.result: You help families open a higher market beyond the next surge.

actions.label: Abolish Ferry Toll
actions.result: You abolish the toll and launch a free ferry between both shores.

actions.label: Answer for Flood
actions.result: You face the flooded market and answer for the broken gates.

actions.label: Acknowledge Report
actions.result: Sava records the report and watches the changed water.

effects.subject: The player returned after sending the Sluice report.
